Epi — installing on macOS
=========================

Copy each format you want into its folder. These are user folders, so no
administrator password is needed.

  Epi.vst3        ->  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
  Epi.component   ->  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/
  Epi.clap        ->  ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/
  Epi.app         ->  /Applications/   (or anywhere; it needs no host)

Then restart your host so it rescans.

These builds are not signed or notarized. macOS will quarantine them on
first download; clear that with either of:

  - right-click the app, choose Open, and confirm — once; or
  - in Terminal:  xattr -cr ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/Epi.vst3
    (repeat for each bundle you copied)

If the AU does not appear in Logic, run once:
  auval -v aumu Epi1 Dnse
